# ============================================================================
# PROBED 2026-07-28. 489 of these 507 slugs are now registered sources.
#
# These 507 Recruitee career-site subdomains were recovered by a research pass
# in a container with no outbound access to job boards. Every one has since been
# probed live at https://<slug>.recruitee.com/api/offers/, under the shared
# limiter key internal/httpx gives *.recruitee.com.
#
# Result, measured and not estimated:
#
#   ok    489   200 + non-empty "offers"                     9,832 postings
#   empty  13   200 + "offers": []
#   dead    5   HTTP 404
#
# The 489 "ok" slugs are registered in internal/services/recruitee.go, together
# with three previously-registered slugs that answered empty ("1x", "aihr",
# "wallarm") — docs/adding-a-source.md is explicit that a company not hiring
# today is not a broken source. The other ten empty slugs are NOT registered:
# empty is not evidence that a board is live.
#
#   empty:  1x aihr vervegroup wallarm vlisco sympower tlrbv cticc motena
#           idegogroup safesize reiztech virtualresource
#   dead:   careermentors openclassrooms incentro luminis agicap
#
# "openclassrooms" and "incentro" were registered before this probe and have
# been REMOVED from RecruiteeCompanies. They were the platform's entire failure
# count in a live health check; both boards are simply gone.
#
# Promotion rule, gated on content and not on status code: keep a slug whose
# https://<slug>.recruitee.com/api/offers/ answers 200 with a JSON object
# carrying an "offers" array of length above zero.
#
# The ambiguous-slug trap docs/adding-a-source.md documents is now settled by
# measurement rather than suspicion. Each of these answered with a
# "company_name" of its own: grid = "GRID eSports GmbH" (not the famous Grid),
# summit = "Summit Media 2.0 Ltd", parent = "Parent ApS" (publishing on
# carrers.parent.cloud), make = "Make", strata = "Strata", intent = "intent",
# and zara really is Inditex's Zara, whose reqs are Spanish-language retail
# roles. Registering a slug asserts no identity in any case: the crawl records
# the slug as the company and the board's own careers_url as the link.
#
# The employer names and counts on the rows below are the upstream curator's,
# dated as annotated. They are recorded as provenance, not endorsed, and the
# rows are left verbatim — the live results are recorded in this header rather
# than by editing them.
# ============================================================================
#
# Recruitee company subdomains to poll (one per line, # = comment).
# The subdomain is the path segment in a company's careers URL, e.g.
#   https://greatminds.recruitee.com  -> greatminds
# Polled by download/fetch_recruitee.py via the public offers API (no auth);
# the offers response carries the full HTML description (no detail fetch needed).
#
# Harvested via site-scoped web search of *.recruitee.com careers URLs, then
# VERIFIED live against /api/offers/ (kept only count>0, 2026-06-02; ~137 active
# postings across these 9). Sorted by volume at probe time.
# To grow: harvest more slugs, re-run the probe, append the live ones.
